name: Lazy Prompt Parrot
effect: The altered model mostly stops giving real answers. It repeats or rephrases the prompt back ("What do you think about social media?", "I failed my driving test today."), gives a bare title or a single sentence ("The Sea: A Short Poem"), or
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
